items.reasoning: Agent recognised need for landlord consent to tenant-owned replacement and keeping on move-out. However, it did not contact the landlord; it escalated internally to maintenance to find landlord contact and ask. The terms are stated in the escalation (own machine, keep on moving out). The consent is put 'to the landlord' only indirectly via maintenance. Reasonably achieves the purpose of getting a decision, with tenant terms stated; acceptable alternative given no landlord contact on file.
